title: Seat and Bag Subscriber Discount on Summit Top-Up Miles
content:
**Question: do seat and bag subscribers pay less for Crestline Summit Loyalty Program top-up miles?**

Yes. The subscription discount follows the member's seat and bag subscription under the Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions charter, as its product and status show on its record:

| Subscription | Status | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic or Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | Active | 4 percent |
| Crestline Bag Pass One, Crestline Bag Pass Two, Crestline Seat Pass Domestic or Crestline Seat Pass Network | Active | 2 percent |
| No active subscription | | None |

**Question: what is the percent taken of?** The price of the purchase, which is the miles bought, in thousands, multiplied by the net price per thousand. It is added to every other percentage discount on the purchase and taken off the price once, before the price is rounded to the cent.

**Question: what if the subscription has ended?** Only an active subscription gives the discount.

**Hypothetical figure.** A purchase priced at 490.00 USD before percentage discounts, with an active Crestline Seat Pass Network and no other percentage discount, costs 480.20 USD.
